verdict.rationale: Cline Kanban runs multiple coding agents in parallel, each card in its own isolated git worktree, and lets you review each card's diff. That gives you the parallel-execution and per-result review parts of the story. The docs never describe running several attempts of the same task side by side, comparing them, and picking a winner. Missing for 10: documented multi-attempt workflow for a single task, side-by-side comparison of attempts, select-and-merge-one flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one

citations.quote: Use Cline Kanban to run multiple coding agents in parallel with isolated git worktrees.
Run many agents in parallel from a web-based task board with per-card worktrees, auto-commit, and dependency chains.
Review diffs in card detail view and leave inline comments.
